en: A colorized historical street scene showing a large Ottoman mosque with a central dome and two tall, slender minarets. The mosque stands to the right, while to the left there is a row of European-style buildings with arcades, shops, awnings, and pedestrians in late‑19th/early‑20th‑century dress walking along the wide street. The image has a printed caption along the right margin and a small website watermark at the bottom.
